summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 32,331,351 ordinary shares at a volume weighted average price of 94.5432 pence per share as part of its existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares were purchased from Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled. This is an ordinary-course share buyback under an ongoing programme, not a tender offer or tender/self-tender. There is no board recommendation or special structural features beyond the cancellation of shares. What to watch: continued execution of the buyback programme and potential impact on EPS.
